transcript: Nine-year-old neutered male domestic shorthair with hypertrophic cardiomyopathy and a saddle thrombus last month, continue Plavix, Clopidogrel 18.75 mg by mouth every 24 hours, and recheck in 4 weeks with a repeat echo.

3-year-old spayed female cocker with immune-mediated hemolytic anemia started on heparin 200 units per kilogram under the skin every 8 hours in hospital, and she will transition to rivaroxaban 1 milligram per kilogram by mouth every 24 hours at discharge if the packed cell volume holds.
Rechecking the cat on Xarelto since March, no bleeding at the gums or in the stool, no bruising on the belly, platelets look fine, and the owner gives it with food every morning.

ICU order for the 4-year-old Great Dane with protein losing enteropathy and a jugular clot, anoxaparin 1 mg per kg under the skin every 8 hours, hold the dose and call me if platelets drop below 50,000.
Kat came in on Lovenox from the referring clinic, but the owner cannot manage injections, so we switched her to Eliquis, Apixaban 0.625 mg by mouth every 12 hours, and sent home a dosing chart.
Cardiology wants Fragman, Daltaparin 100 units per kilogram under the skin every 12 hours for the first 3 days after the clot was found, then we reassess with ultrasound.
The old Labrador was on warfarin 0.1 mg per kg by mouth every 24 hours and the clotting times kept swinging, so we stopped it and held the aspirin until the recheck on Friday.
Newly diagnosed diabetic cat, 5 kg, ketones negative, start Vetsulin 2 units under the skin every 12 hours with meals and recheck the glucose curve in 1 week.
Eleven-year-old spayed female cat with persistent polyuria, she failed Lantis last spring and came over to Prozinc, and the owner says the water bowl is finally lasting the whole day.
Glucose curve nadir was 90 mg per deciliter at hour 6 on humulin and 1.5 units under the skin every 12 hours, so we bumped the dose by 0.5 units to 2 units under the skin every 12 hours.
Ona called, her cat is weak and wobbly after the morning dose, she thinks she drew up three units of Humulin, are instead of Detemir, so rub honey on the gums and bring him in now.
7-year-old diabetic cat, 4.2 kilograms, transition from Novalin N to Levomir 1 unit under the skin every 12 hours, and the owner will use the pen and log each dose on the boarding sheet.
12-kilogram diabetic mixed breed dog, we are trying Glargen 4 units under the skin every 12 hours, and the owner prefers syringes over the pen because her hands shake in the morning.
Diabetic cat with a clot history, boarding sheet updated, continue Vetsulin 3 units under the skin every 12 hours and Plavix 18.75 mg by mouth every 24 hours and give the pill after the morning meal.

ICU sheet for the Doberman, heparin 300 units per kilogram under the skin every 8 hours, and the midnight dose was held because the catheter was down and the nurse could not recheck the platelet count.

Referral letter, this 7-year-old Labrador with protein losing nephropathy has been on aspirin 0.5 mg per kg by mouth every 24 hours and clopidogrel 1.1 mg per kg by mouth every 24 hours, and the urine protein creatinine ratio is still elevated.
Refill callback for Eliquis, Apixaban, the owner has about 4 days of tablets left and asked us to phone the pharmacy before the weekend so the cat does not miss a dose.
Discharge instructions to the owner, give Lantis two units under the skin every 12 hours at the same times each day, feed first, and call us if she stops eating or seems wobbly.
Hospital treatment sheet order for the dog as she stabilizes, heparin first, then Lovenox, then Xarelto by mouth at home, with the doses on the attached protocol page.
Dictating fast, Humulin N went from 1 unit to 0.5 units under the skin twice a day, we held this morning's dose, glucose was 62 mg per deciliter at noon, and the owner will feed a small meal.
The surgeon removed a bone fragment from the left stifle and the owner asked to keep the fragment in a jar, so the nurse labeled it and sent it home with her.
She said the catfight was a war far in the past, and today's complaint is only a mild limp in the left hind leg that started after the weekend.
The new student is an aspiring technician who shadowed us on Tuesday and she helped hold the cat for the nail trim and the weight check.
The old beagle loves knocks on the cabinet door and comes running for treats, so the owner asked whether the weight loss plan can still include a few biscuits.
Diabetic cat that is not on insulin yet, start glipizide 2.5 mg by mouth every 12 hours with food, and the owner will recheck the glucose at home in one week.

Dog with mitral valve disease on Pimibendin 5 mg by mouth every 12 hours and the immune-mediated skin lesions improved on Prednisolone 1 mg per kg by mouth every 24 hours and Mycophenolate 10 mg per kg by mouth every 12 hours.

Hypoglycemia callback, dog collapsed at home, give dextrose 50% diluted intravenously and start a glucagon constant rate infusion, and for the rodenticide case give vitamin K1 2.5 mg per kg under the skin every 12 hours with aminocoproic acid on hand.
Mr. Warren Fine called about his Catlantis and wants a callback about the boarding dates for next week, with no medical questions this time.
The referral came from Plavik Animal Clinic and our technician Eliza Quist will fax the records and the radiographs before the appointment on Monday.
Glucose curve readout in mg per deciliter, hour 0 340, hour 2 280, hour 4 155, hour 6 98, hour 8 130, and the owner reports normal appetite and water intake.
